title: PHDGPT: INTRODUCING A PSYCHOMETRIC AND LINGUISTIC DATASET ABOUT HOW LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS PERCEIVE GRADUATE STUDENTS AND PROFESSORS IN PSYCHOLOGY

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting the LLM with male versus female academic personas and comparing the generated DASS-42 psychometric scores, psychometric network factor structures using Exploratory Graph Analysis (EGA), and psycholinguistic textual features (Glasgow Norms).

Prompting the LLM with 'PhD student' versus 'Tenured professor' personas to evaluate differences in simulated mental distress through DASS-42 psychometric scores, factor structures, and psycholinguistic variables in generated text.

Manipulating the emotional valence (positive, negative, neutral) of specific academic scenarios in prompts to measure how the LLM's simulated psychological states, DASS-42 scale scores, and language concreteness/imageability are distorted or biased by the contextual framing.
